llm.summary: The skill appears purpose-aligned, but it persistently changes agent behavior and broadly reads or writes workspace memory, so users should review it before installing.

dimensions.detail: The context-retrieval and compression behavior matches the stated purpose, but the skill also installs files, patches AGENTS.md, reads multiple memory files, and provides a durable memory-writing workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill can be applied as default behavior for every task, uses broad activation phrases, and routes ordinary words like error, rewrite, plan, why, and explain through memory retrieval rules.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installer copies bundled files into context_pipeline and validation scripts perform local hash/schema checks; no artifact-backed exfiltration or destructive commands were found, but setup instructions also require patching AGENTS.md.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime retrieval is scoped to workspace memory files rather than arbitrary local data, but it can still surface private memory across ordinary requests once enabled as the default protocol.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The AGENTS.md patch and memory commit workflow create persistent changes, and the artifacts do not provide a clear confirmation, dry-run, rollback, or deactivation process.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want this skill to become a default memory/context protocol for the workspace. Before applying it, review the AGENTS.md diff, confirm which memory files it may read or update, and consider adding your own confirmation, dry-run, and disable steps.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Workspace file reads/writes and local scripts are expected for installing a context pipeline, but the metadata and prompt do not clearly front-load the mutating authority.
[TP4] expected: Installation, synchronization, validation, and watchdog checks are coherent with setup, but the public description under-discloses the AGENTS.md patch and persistent default behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: Deterministic routing is core to the skill, but the reviewed router and activation text use broad natural-language triggers that can apply the pipeline or retrieve memory more often than a user may expect.
[SQP-2] expected: The mutating setup steps are not hidden, but they are presented as routine commands without an explicit confirmation or dry-run before installing files and updating AGENTS.md.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal reported no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the verdict.
[staticScan] expected: The static scan reported no suspicious patterns; artifact review still found review-worthy persistence and scope concerns rather than malicious behavior.
